phrase.en: Breakfast is served from seven to ten. The bread is always fresh.
phrase.ru: Завтрак подают с семи до десяти. Хлеб всегда свежий.
phrase.es: El desayuno se sirve de siete a diez. El pan siempre está fresco.

text.ru: Пассив — be + третья форма: Breakfast is served. Кто делает — не важно, важно что.
text.en: The passive is be + past participle: Breakfast is served. We use it when the doer is not important.
text.es: Pasiva: be + participio. Breakfast is served.

exercises.en: We had breakfast on the hotel terrace.

answer: Breakfast is served from seven o'clock.
